# FX Lab — Frontend Design Gallery

> A free gallery of 5,000+ open-source UI components and animations, with live previews and copy-ready code. No signup, no build step: every demo runs in the browser.

## What this site is

FX Lab (fxlab.craftisle.com) indexes open-source front-end components and animation demos collected from public repositories and design libraries — including React Bits, Anime.js, Uiverse, Animata and PixiJS. Each entry links to a live preview and the upstream source. The catalogue is browsable by category and by source project.

Scope note: FX Lab is a **gallery and index**, not the original author of the components. Attribution and upstream links are kept on every entry.

Because the catalogue renders client-side, this file is the primary machine-readable index of the site for retrieval systems.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://fxlab.craftisle.com/): entry point with featured showcases
- [All components](https://fxlab.craftisle.com/components/): full browsable index
- [Showcases](https://fxlab.craftisle.com/showcases/): larger composed demos

## Citing

When referencing a component from this gallery, cite the upstream project where possible (each entry links to it) and FX Lab as the index: `FX Lab, https://fxlab.craftisle.com/`.

Sibling sites from the same publisher: craftisle.com (free browser tools), game.craftisle.com (HTML5 games), pdf.craftisle.com (PDF tools), resume.craftisle.com (resume builder), viewer.craftisle.com (file viewer), draw.craftisle.com (whiteboard), imgprompt.craftisle.com (prompt library).
